About Plasma

Plasma is building the primary account for global money.

Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world.

Our first product, Plasma One, is a global money account: a place to receive, hold, send funds in seconds, earn yield and spend with a card in the local economy.

Underneath is the Plasma network, built from first principles for stablecoin payments. Stablecoins make dollars faster, cheaper and more reliable to move.

The opportunity is to become where all global money lands first: where income arrives, balances grow, payments move, businesses operate, and new financial products are built.


The Team & Our Story

We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses.

We operate with trust, clarity, and ambition: own your craft, move with urgency, contribute beyond your lane, back your teammates, debate rigorously, and keep raising the bar for what great means.

Customer Experience

Plasma is scaling its customer-facing operations across international markets, and we’re growing the Customer Experience Team to match. You’ll join an established team and take ownership of coverage for the CET time zone, making sure our customers get great support when they need it most.

You’ll work across the full customer journey, from first contact through to resolution. Because we’re still building out our playbook, your input will directly shape the processes, standards, and team culture as we grow. You won’t just follow the process; you’ll help refine it.

Some flexibility in working hours & weekend shifts will be needed to support coverage and the occasional busy period. We’re looking for a hard-working self-starter who thrives in a fast-moving startup environment and is committed to the mission alongside the rest of the team.

The role

  • Own the customer experience day-to-day: Be the first person our customers reach when something goes wrong or they need help. You will handle inbound queries across chat, email, and support tooling, and take accountability for the quality and speed of every response.

  • Be the right hand of the Ops lead: Work directly alongside the Head of Operations to build out processes, identify gaps, and support decisions as we scale the team internationally. This is not a back-office support role. You will be involved in how we think about operations.

  • Build the foundations: We are early. Many of the processes, templates, and escalation paths do not exist yet. You will create them. From response frameworks to internal guides, you will help lay the groundwork the team will rely on as we grow.

  • Support international team scaling: As we hire Ops team members in new markets, you will help onboard them, share knowledge, and maintain consistency in how we deliver for customers across regions.

  • Spot problems before they become patterns: Track issues across the customer base, flag recurring themes to Product and Engineering, and help prioritise fixes that actually move the needle for customers.

  • Work across teams: Collaborate with Compliance, KYC, and Product to make sure the customer experience is joined up, especially during onboarding and verification flows where things can go wrong quickly.

  • Represent the customer internally: Your proximity to customer feedback is valuable. Use it. Bring customer insight into internal conversations and push for improvements that matter.

  • Be Flexible with Shift Rotation: Most weeks you’ll work the normal Mon-Fri, however team members currently rotate weekend shifts which means that you may be required to work a weekend shift once every 6 weeks. You’ll then be able to take those days worked off the following week.

The Bar

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in customer operations, customer success, or a support role, ideally within fintech, payments, or crypto. We will consider strong candidates from outside these sectors if the fit is right.

  • Someone who takes ownership. You do not wait to be told. When something is broken or missing, you fix it or flag it. You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching.

  • Clear and direct in how you communicate. You can write a helpful, professional response under pressure and explain a complex situation simply. You know the difference between being thorough and overcomplicating things.

  • Competent English Language - our team communicates in english so being competent with the language is a requirement.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. This is an early-stage company. Processes will change, priorities will shift, and some days you will be figuring things out as you go. You see that as interesting rather than frustrating. Preferably, you have worked at a fast-paced tech company.

  • Genuinely curious about crypto. You do not need deep technical knowledge, but you need to understand the basics of how stablecoins and digital assets work and be motivated to learn more. Our customers live in this space.

  • Organised under pressure. You can manage a queue, prioritise effectively, and keep quality high when things are busy.

  • Collaborative by default. You work well with people in different functions, different time zones, and different levels of seniority. Building the team abroad means working with people you may never meet in person, and you are good at that.

Nice to have

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up where you had to build or rebuild processes, not just follow them.

  • Exposure to Intercom, Zendesk, Freshdesk, or similar support tooling in a live production environment.

  • Any familiarity with KYC or compliance workflows as they relate to customer onboarding.

  • Experience supporting or managing a small team, even informally, or helping onboard new colleagues.

  • An interest in how stablecoin and DeFi products work and the customer challenges they create.

  • Multilingual skills that could support customer communication across our international markets.

What's in it for you

  • Above-market salary for the level of the role, with token compensation.

  • A beautiful London HQ with gym access and daily food, for those who thrive in an office environment. Visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're joining from abroad.

  • Premium health insurance for you and your family, fully covered by Plasma.

  • Monthly wellness budget, whether that's the gym, therapy, sauna, or massage.

  • All the tools and tech you need to operate at your best.

  • Real ownership and responsibility from day one, with your work shipping to hundreds of thousands of people, moving millions of dollars every day.

Data Protection & Privacy
We are committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. Any personal information you provide during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable local data protection laws.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
 
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. We are seeking a talented and experienced Trading Product Director to join our dynamic team. As a Trading Product Director, you will be responsible for driving product growth and execution of our crypto-related products and services. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, marketing, and business development, to define product strategy, prioritize features, and deliver exceptional user experiences. The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of the crypto landscape, possess strong data analytical and communication skills, and be passionate about driving innovation in the crypto industry.

  • Platform Enhancement: Contribute to the continuous evolution of the platform, ensuring it supports cross-border distribution and new product lines (including tokenized RWAs where applicable) while adhering to regulatory and operational requirements.

What We Look For In You:

  • Min 5+ years of experience in product management, with a strong focus on crypto trading platforms, derivatives, blockchain/digital assets, or financial infrastructure.
  • Domain expert on derivatives products (perpetuals/futures/options), including margining, order workflows, and market microstructure.•Proven track record leading large-scale trading platform transformations across Web and App (e.g., unified account models, cross-margin, or multi-product trading experiences).

  • Experience delivering regulatory-sensitive launches and partnering closely with compliance/legal teams; familiarity with Singapore, EU (MiCA) and other major jurisdictions is preferred.

Applied Research at Prime

We turn a workflow into tasks, environments, evaluations, and reward signals, run post-training experiments against real baselines, and deploy what works. When a result looks good, we find out whether the gain came from the model or from the data, harness, inference, or infrastructure. The reusable parts become shared research, open-source systems, and product capabilities.

Every Applied Research role is externally facing. Most researchers work directly with customers, users, or research partners while maintaining a substantive research agenda.

Representative early problems

  • Build an interactive verification environment where an agent reads a specification, writes or repairs RTL, invokes simulation or formal tools, interprets failures, and iterates toward a verified result.

  • Train long-horizon agents to recover from design and tool failures, preserve useful state, and generalize across blocks, designs, and constraint sets.

  • Interactive environments where agents use EDA tools to modify designs, debug failures, and plan multi-step work.

  • Comfort owning ambiguous problems and keeping partners and teammates current as you resolve them.

Digital Asset builds the technologies that are reshaping the foundations of financial markets. Our mission is to create the world’s most trusted, privacy-enabled, and interoperable digital infrastructure for global finance.

At the heart of this mission is the Canton Network - the blockchain purpose-built for institutional finance. Governed by the Canton Foundation with participation from leading financial institutions, it is the proven link between the promise of blockchain and the power of global finance.

Founded in 2014 and headquartered in New York City, with offices in London, Zurich, Budapest, Hong Kong, and Sydney— we are on a mission to transform finance— and that transformation is now playing out rapidly on the Canton Network.

If you’re interested in playing a crucial role at the intersection of traditional and crypto-capital markets and want to help bring the next trillion dollars of finance on-chain, join us.

About the role:

The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is DA's most forward-leaning technical role: part of CX Engineering, but operating ahead of signed deals — in the room with a prospective client's engineering and risk teams, building the prototype that proves the Canton Network can solve their problem before anyone signs anything.  The FDE moves between two modes: heads-down building — prototyping smart contracts and registry apps on Canton and Daml, wiring up DA Registry and DA Utilities components, standing up a demo environment overnight — and heads-up presenting — walking a bank's Head of Digital Assets or a stablecoin issuer's CTO through the architecture you just built and defending it under real technical scrutiny.  The FDE works directly with Sales, Solutions Design, and Network Strategy to deliver working code.

Responsibilities:

  • Owns the technical narrative for strategic prospective and early-stage clients — translates a prospect's problem statement into a working Canton Network prototype, registry model, or demo application in days to weeks, not quarters
  • Designs and builds prototype and demo code on Canton and Daml — smart contracts, registry apps, DA Registry and DA Utilities components, integration adapters — that hold up to technical scrutiny from engineers at the world's largest banks, financial market infrastructures, and crypto-native and stablecoin companies
  • Partners directly with prospective clients' engineering, risk, and product teams to scope proof-of-concept and pilot architectures across asset tokenization, collateral mobility, on-chain payments, and stablecoin use cases
  • Serves as DA's technical face in front of senior engineering and business audiences at financial market infrastructures (clearinghouses, custodians, exchanges, CSDs) and the largest crypto-native and stablecoin companies — translating Canton Network and Global Synchronizer concepts so they land with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Builds reusable prototyping accelerators, registry templates, and demo assets that shorten the path from first conversation to signed pilot for the rest of CX Engineering and Solutions Design
  • Feeds field learnings back into DA Product and Engineering — the gaps you hit building a demo for a tier-one bank or a stablecoin issuer are exactly the signal Product needs to prioritize the roadmap
  • Partners with Sales, Solutions Design, and Network Strategy to shape deal scope, sequence delivery, and pull in the right specialists at the right time
  • Acts as a senior technical resource for New York-based and headquarters-facing engagements with financial market infrastructures and global banks headquartered in or near New York
  • Assumes additional duties and responsibilities from time to time, as needed

What We're Looking For:

  • Able to leverage previous experience in software engineering to deliver production-grade systems fast and credible prototypes under deal-cycle time pressure
  • Knowledge and experience with Daml, Canton Network and ability to ramp up quickly
  • Comfortable owning a client-facing technical relationship at the CTO / Head of Engineering / Head of Digital Assets level without support — able to design an architecture live in a room and defend it under questioning
  • Full-stack builder: equally comfortable in smart contract/registry logic, backend integration, and enough front-end to make a demo land
  • Strong financial services or capital markets domain knowledge — fluency in how a clearinghouse, custodian, bank, or stablecoin issuer actually operates
  • Experience scoping and building proofs of concept or pilots in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where requirements are still being discovered
  • Consistent ability translating complex technical concepts for both senior technical and non-technical stakeholders

Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Field Sales Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square's mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most.

If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

  • Run a full-cycle, self-sourced sales motion: generate leads, identify needs, deliver compelling demos, and close deals across Square's full product suite.

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

Master your verticals and sell with precision

  • Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

  • Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.
  • Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.
  • Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

You Have
